requirements.title: IOR argument restrictions
requirements.definition: I and J shall each be integer or a BOZ literal constant; same-kind integer operands are required, and both operands shall not be BOZ literals.

pending.IOR-I-integer-or-boz: Positive source plan calls IOR with an integer I and with an actual BOZ literal I; mutate I to a real expression as source-control only, with no diagnostic facet.
pending.IOR-J-integer-or-boz: Positive source plan calls IOR with an integer J and with an actual BOZ literal J; mutate J to a real expression as source-control only, with no diagnostic facet.
pending.IOR-integer-kinds-match: Positive source plan uses same-kind integer operands and records a source-control mutation with mismatched integer kinds; no required diagnostic is claimed.
pending.IOR-not-both-boz: Positive source plan uses exactly one actual BOZ literal such as IOR(Z'05',2) and mutates both operands to BOZ literals as source-control only.

requirements.definition: The result is the same type and kind as I for integer I; otherwise it is the same type and kind as J.

requirements.title: IOR combines operands by inclusive OR of corresponding bits
requirements.definition: The IOR result bit is 1 for operand bit pairs 1/1, 1/0, or 0/1, and 0 only for 0/0, using the 16.3 bit model.

pending.IOR-inclusive-or-truth-table: Initialize a result sentinel to zero, assign IOR(5,3), and assert by BTEST/POPCNT that bits 0, 1, and 2 are set; mutate to IEOR or IAND to change the bit pattern.
pending.IOR-negative-operand-bit-pattern: Use IOR(-1,0) and IOR(-1,-1); compare every position from 0 through BIT_SIZE(default integer)-1 by BTEST against -1 companions, never by numeric interpretation of a leftmost set bit.
